statusReason: OB-Recover captured 1056 successful decoder returns but validation produced 0 replaceable candidates, so nothing was replaced and source identity could not be established

falseReplacement.note: no replacement happened at all, so a zero here is vacuous and is NOT evidence of correctness

sourceIntegrity.note: the CDP source read was issued against scriptId 200 from the first navigation epoch after a retry reload; it returned an empty string, which is consistent with a stale id and is NOT evidence about how the extension reads a live script

safeRejectionRate.note: the reference marks all 823 positions determinate, so the negative denominator is 0

verdict: not-pass, blocked before any replacement could be evaluated

environment.whyHeadful: a plain headless Chrome 155 receives HTTP 403 from this site (recon/headless-probe.json), so the headless entry point cannot load the page at all

engineObservation.note: capture itself worked at scale on this site

diagnosis.immediate: validation rejected every decoder group, so dry-run had nothing to offer and apply had nothing to do
diagnosis.rejectionMix: 13 groups unstable (same arguments returned different values) and 17 groups failed
diagnosis.notedEngineMessage: entry breakpoint did not land inside the function body (top frame is not the target function)
diagnosis.hypothesisNotClaimed: if the entry breakpoint lands outside the target function, the recorded return value can come from the wrong frame, which would make one argument set look unstable. This is a hypothesis only; no root cause was established and no product change was made.

harnessNotes: attempt 1 took the engine snapshot too early (the page was briefly unresponsive while paused) and saw 0 hits; it is archived as raw-run.attempt1-early-snapshot.json
attempt 2 reloaded while the page was paused and landed on chrome-error; archived as raw-run.attempt2-reload-error.json
attempt 3 created the tab at about:blank, so discovery had no scripts and capture-start was refused; archived as raw-run.attempt3-blank-tab-no-candidates.json
attempt 4 (this record) loaded the target first, connected, started capture, reloaded with a bounded retry, and produced the numbers above
the empty source read came from a stale scriptId after that retry; a clean single navigation run is required to measure source integrity

pageLiveness.observed: in attempt 1 the inspected page stopped answering while capture was active
pageLiveness.interpretation: observation only, cause not determined; it is the same symptom class as the Phase 3 hang, which remains not reproduced / root cause unknown and is NOT claimed as fixed
pageLiveness.inThisAttempt: the page answered at the end and stopCapture returned

notStored: cookies, GuestId, request ciphertext, response Result
